adjudication.reason: G2 is a hard gate of the round's main goal; the failure is an implementable timing/RAM-inference defect, not a missing tool or device. The G0/G1 candidate is stable and resource headroom is large (ERAM 4/300).

candidate_binding.rule: repair creates a new derived candidate; old manifests are read-only and must not be edited or reused as PASS for the new hashes

scope.objective: Fix the 187.5 MHz timing failure by removing combinational distributed-RAM reads (cmem[4096x16], htab[1024x53]) and pipelining as needed, then rerun G1 regression and one TD G2 attempt on the same small top.
forbidden_changes: external port/interface semantics or frame commit/abort behavior
format-v1.md frozen format, zlib wrapper, fixed+stored subset, Bayer mapping
187.5 MHz target clock, SDC thresholds, adding false paths or multicycle exceptions
production files, top-level integration, three algorithms, R10F/T03 enums
semantic_steps: 1. Replace combinational reads of cmem/htab with synchronous ERAM/registered-read structures; pipeline match/emit path only as needed to preserve interface and throughput.
2. Keep external ports and frame commit/abort/CRC/length semantics byte-identical; record diff and new hashes.
3. Rerun P2 13/13 + P3 20/20 regressions on the new candidate; require 0 mismatch, vlog Errors 0 / Warnings 0, no X; stop if any fails.
4. Run exactly one TD session (the remaining 3rd of the package budget) on the same a1_eng_top and 187.5 MHz SDC; synth+route within 30 minutes; save logs, timing, area, CDC-if-available.
5. Freeze new manifest (new file, do not overwrite r0), write p4/result-r1.md with routed WNS/TNS/resources/throughput and explicit PASS/FAIL; no bitgen/download.

gates.G1_regression: P2 13/13 + P3 20/20, 0 sample/byte mismatch, vlog 0/0, no X; must complete before TD.
gates.G2: TD exit=0; Confidence=Routed; SWNS/STNS/HWNS >= 0 (record values); 0 violations; resources within PH1P100SBG484; no broad false paths.
gates.throughput: recomputed from G1 cycles at 187.5 MHz; 1080p >= 77.76 MB/s required, 97.2 target; do not use theoretical bandwidth.
gates.evidence: new candidate manifest with per-file SHA256 and 0 mismatches; raw logs; timing/area reports; independent tester report.

stop_conditions: Any P2/P3 regression mismatch, X propagation, or vlog error -> stop before TD.
After the RTL fix, if synthesis WNS < 0 -> stop; do not route, do not try another seed.
If route does not reach Routed within the single 30-minute session -> stop; no 4th session.
If G2 passes but throughput drops below 77.76 MB/s -> FAIL, no threshold change.
Two consecutive no-progress attempts or any request to relax constraints -> blocked, return evidence.

write_scope.rule: do not overwrite T10.a1-eng-freeze/CANDIDATE-MANIFEST.json or p4/result.md (r0 evidence); use -r1 names

protected: all existing files outside the allowed codec dirs and the P4 run dir
production top, B01 bit/CWC, old runs, workflow/tasks.json
R10F contract, T03 enums, SDC files other than the P4 r1 copy

after_development.tester: one new independent integrated tester for T10.a1-eng-freeze r1
tester_must: bind the new r1 manifest and hashes
independently rerun P2 13/13 and P3 20/20 on the new candidate
verify routed G2 report, WNS/TNS, resources, and throughput recomputation
write test-reports/T10.a1-eng-freeze-r1-integrated.md with one unique verdict heading
after_development.on_pass: P4 PASS (G0/G1/G2 small top); T10 A+ offline closed loop established, but no G3/board/real-data claim.
after_development.on_fail: P4 remains WARN/blocked; round closes at 3/4 PASS; timing repair becomes next-round theme.
